item.title: DuckDB 2.0 Claims to Be Faster. I Put It to the Test
JSON Tiles: Fast Analytics on Semi-Structured Data (2021)
item.description: Abstract: Developers often prefer flexibility over upfront schema design, making semi-structured data formats such as JSON increasingly popular. Large amounts of JSON data are therefore stored and analyzed by relational database systems. (1 source: lobsters)
